preamble: Spirantization of a uvular stop to a velar fricative. The documented case is Georgian: the Old Georgian uvular stop written ჴ (qar), described as /qʰ/ or /q/, merged with the velar fricative ხ /x/, and the letter ჴ fell out of use. Turkic q > χ spirantization produces a uvular fricative and belongs to the q > χ cell.

examples.note: Old Georgian uvular ჴ merged with velar ხ /x/ (phonetically ranging from velar to uvular depending on context). The atlas has no separate aspirated-uvular symbol, so the change is filed under q.
